Package com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.diagnostic

Class DiagnosticReport

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.diagnostic.DiagnosticReport
public final class DiagnosticReport extends Object
Shared formatting, classification vocabulary, and file output for the /sb diagnostic commands. Every finding reaches the operator through feedback(java.lang.String, java.util.List<com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.diagnostic.DiagnosticReport.Row>, java.lang.String, java.nio.file.Path, int) and the written report; none is logged.
